categories.main_business_segments: Piotech Inc. primarily engages in the research, development, production, sales, and technical services of high-end semiconductor specialized equipment. Its main product lines include thin film deposition equipment such as PECVD, ALD, SACVD, HDPCVD, and Flowable CVD series, as well as advanced bonding equipment and supporting metrology devices used in 3D integration. These products are widely applied in integrated circuit logic chips, memory chip manufacturing, and 3D integration fields.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced chemical vapor deposition (CVD) technologies including plasma-enhanced CVD (PECVD), atomic layer deposition (ALD), sub-atmospheric pressure CVD (SACVD), high-density plasma CVD (HDPCVD), and flowable CVD. It also develops advanced wafer bonding technologies such as hybrid bonding and fusion bonding, with precise alignment and bonding strength measurement capabilities. The production methods emphasize modular reaction chamber design, plasma stability control, gas flow management, and temperature control to achieve high film quality and equipment throughput.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Piotech serves semiconductor wafer fabrication plants, focusing on integrated circuit manufacturers producing logic and memory chips, including advanced packaging and 3D integration sectors. Its customers are primarily domestic Chinese semiconductor fabs, with expanding penetration in the growing Chinese semiconductor equipment market. The company maintains stable relationships with major chip manufacturers and provides customized high-performance equipment and comprehensive after-sales services.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with headquarters and production bases in Shenyang, Shanghai, Beijing, and Zhejiang. It has established subsidiaries in the United States, Japan, and the British Virgin Islands to support overseas procurement and market expansion. Its sales and operations are predominantly focused on the Chinese mainland semiconductor market, which is the largest global semiconductor equipment market.
categories.supply_chain_position: Piotech operates primarily in the midstream segment of the semiconductor equipment supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and supplying specialized semiconductor fabrication equipment. It sources components globally but has established a diversified supplier network to mitigate supply chain risks. The company also invests in upstream semiconductor equipment component suppliers through equity investments to strengthen its supply chain stability.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous innovation in thin film deposition and 3D integration bonding technologies, maintaining high R&D intensity with over 18% of revenue invested in research. It focuses on expanding product lines, improving equipment performance, and developing new platforms and reaction chambers. Strategic R&D directions include enhancing PECVD and ALD process coverage, advancing bonding precision and throughput, and developing energy-efficient, cost-effective equipment to meet evolving semiconductor manufacturing demands.
categories.revenue_model: Piotech generates revenue primarily through direct sales of semiconductor fabrication equipment, including thin film deposition systems and advanced bonding devices. Additional revenue streams include sales of spare parts and provision of technical services related to equipment maintenance and process support. The company employs a direct sales model with customized equipment solutions tailored to customer production needs.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The global thin film deposition equipment market is dominated by international giants such as Applied Materials, Lam Research, and Tokyo Electron, which hold approximately 70% market share. In advanced bonding equipment for 3D integration, key competitors include EV Group, Tokyo Electron, BESI, and ASMPT. Piotech positions itself as a leading domestic high-end semiconductor equipment manufacturer in China, with competitive technology and growing market share, but still faces strong competition from established global players.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: Piotech has demonstrated rapid growth with 2024 revenue reaching approximately RMB 4.1 billion, a 51.7% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 688 million, up 3.86%. The company’s total assets grew 53.61% to RMB 15.3 billion, and net assets increased nearly 15% to RMB 5.28 billion. It has a strong order backlog of about RMB 9.4 billion, supporting continued growth. The company’s compound annual growth rate since 2018 is approximately 96.79%. R&D investment increased by 31.26% in 2024, reflecting its commitment to innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Piotech emphasizes its advanced proprietary technologies, high equipment stability, and broad process coverage in thin film deposition and 3D integration bonding. Its products offer high throughput, low production costs, and superior film quality, meeting stringent semiconductor manufacturing requirements. The company provides highly customized solutions and responsive after-sales service, leveraging its deep understanding of domestic customer needs and close proximity to major Chinese fabs. Its focus on energy efficiency and green manufacturing further differentiates its offerings.
